faq.subheadline: Complete answers about the platform, verification, and how Upahku works.

items.question: What is Upahku?
items.answer: Upahku is a platform that helps Indonesian informal workers (handymen, technicians, mechanics, photographers, etc.) build verified professional reputations. We connect quality workers with customers who need their services.

items.question: Is the platform free?
items.answer: Registration and basic platform usage are completely free. We offer paid business packages for companies that want to increase visibility and get premium features like top search spots.

items.question: How does reputation verification work?
items.answer: Every completed job is recorded as proof of work with before/after photos and customer confirmation. Plus community verification from local leaders. All this contributes to a transparent trust score.

items.question: What if there's a problem with the work?
items.answer: We have a transparent rating and review system. If issues arise, customers can report through our dispute resolution feature. Our team will help mediate between both parties.

items.question: How do I register as a worker?
items.answer: Simply register with email or phone number, complete your profile, and you're ready to receive jobs. We'll help you verify your skills and experience.
